adjudication.rationale: The diff does show `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the serialized `@embedding` without persisting anything, and the client controller defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`. However, the added `embedding.hbs` template contains no Save button (it only lists hosts and has an “Add Host” button), and host changes are actually persisted via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` (`host.save(props)` / `destroyRecord()`). So the claim about a Save button “silently doing nothing” isn’t verifiable from the diff, but the no-op update route/action is a real, diff-grounded cleanup/architecture concern (dead/placeholder endpoint).
